summary: "A 10 Bagger Like This May Never Happen Again" (Business With Brian, 2026-05-24) is a quantum-computing deep dive built around his "woodshed signal" — he called a sub-$1 quantum stock in September 2023 that ran 2,000%+ ($10,000 → ~$224,000), arguing real preparation shows before the crowd arrives. Framework: all four quantum architectures are now publicly investable for the first time — superconducting, trapped ion, neutral atom, photonic — with 7 public pure plays and 3 more IPOs coming. He introduces the "37% rule": watch first, build a baseline, then act when something beats everything observed. Established names: D-Wave (QBTS — annealing, 2025 revenue +179%, Jan-Feb 2026 contracts already exceeded all of 2025, acquired a second gate-model architecture; discussed positively but no actionable buy — UNCERTAIN) and IonQ (IONQ — trapped ion, backlog ~5x since Oct 2025, revenue +202%, $1.8B SkyWater acquisition, cleared for US defense work; also UNCERTAIN at current prices). Rigetti (RGTI — HOLD — superconducting gate model, but 63% of 2026 revenue rests on two contracts with deliveries slipped to H2 2026). Quantum Computing Inc (QUBT — AVOID — $682K revenue, going-concern warning, securities-fraud lawsuits, short-seller claims it overstated its NASA relationship). New entrants: Infleqtion (neutral atom, Nvidia selected it for two programs, $32M revenue, hardware on the ISS), Xanadu (photonic, plus the PennyLane software platform with 160K monthly downloads), Horizon Quantum (hardware-agnostic middleware, SPAC'd in March), plus quantum-security microcaps CLSQ and Arqit (ARQQ — pre-revenue, UNCERTAIN).
